Eihwaz — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᛇ
resilience holding on depth strength through difficulty

Upright meaning

Eihwaz is the resilience rune — it shows up when you're being tested, and it says: you're going to make it through this.

Think of a really old, deep-rooted tree. It bends in storms but doesn't break. That's what Eihwaz is asking you to be right now. Not rigid, not brittle — flexible and deeply grounded.

Something significant is shifting within you, even if it's not visible yet. This kind of deep change takes time. Don't try to rush it or force it into the open before it's ready.

Just keep your feet planted and hold on.

Eihwaz doesn't reverse.
